content.short: Bridgers provides cross-chain swap and bridge-style liquidity routes across multiple blockchains and assets.
content.description: Bridgers focuses on cross-chain Web3 interactions. Its product messaging highlights transparent routing, diverse protocols, multiple blockchain and asset connections, and technical support for users moving liquidity across ecosystems. Fast, transparent, and diverse cross-chain protocols, seamlessly connecting multiple blockchains and assets, with comprehensive technical support, defining a new generation of decentralized Web3 interactions. That makes the app relevant for TON users who need a real DeFi action rather than only a token information page.
content.meta: Bridgers provides cross-chain swap and bridge-style liquidity routes across multiple blockchains. Discover its TON role and related apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
